name: Barbara Cabot
background: Barbara Cabot was a Democratic nominee for Laramie County commissioner in 2026 and lost the November 3 general election. She won the Democratic primary and finished behind the three Republican nominees in the general election, according to official Laramie County results and contemporaneous local coverage. A campaign website, cabot4lc.com, later displayed only a thank-you note that the site was winding down. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official candidate roster, county election results, or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
